patch.value: beads validate --no-workspace is a silent no-op (runtime normalizes flag to workspace:false)

Found during the 2026-06-12 fleet verification against pm CLI 2026.6.12 (companion task pm-cli-website-k0lw). The pm runtime normalizes --no-workspace to {workspace:false}, but the validate handler only checked options['no-workspace']/options['noWorkspace'], so the flag never disabled the workspace cross-check: a dangling dependency that exists in the workspace was reported as a cross_workspace_dependency WARNING (exit 0) instead of a dangling_dependency ERROR (exit 1). Fix: resolveWorkspaceCheck() mirroring resolvePreserveIds normalization; validate handler now honors workspace:false/'false'/'0', noWorkspace:true, no-workspace:true. Regression test added covering every flag shape.

pm beads validate <file> --no-workspace reports dangling_dependency ERROR exit 1 even when the dependency exists in the workspace; default behavior unchanged (cross_workspace_dependency WARNING exit 0)
